column1: # FireCraft corpus — digests pinned by `cargo run -p xtask -- corpus-gen`.
# fixtures/ are clean-room generated (committed); incoming/ holds real
# Fireworks files, which stay uncommitted. assets/library/ are the
# re-created Common Library files (regenerated by library-gen, pinned
# here so the round-trip battery covers them).
